mapper.select: SELECT R.ID AS id, R.NAME AS name, R.CATEGORY AS category, R.ADDRESS AS address, NVL(R.SOLO_INDEX, 0) AS solo_index, NVL(R.AVG_RATING, 0) AS avgRating, NVL(R.RATING_COUNT, 0) AS rating_count, R.STATUS AS status, TO_CHAR(R.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt, TO_CHAR(R.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS updatedAt FROM MP_RESTAURANT R WHERE R.DELETED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY R.ID

SELECT ID AS id, NAME AS name, DESCRIPTION AS description, CATEGORY AS category, AVG_RATING AS avgRating, RATING_COUNT AS rating_count, SOLO_INDEX AS solo_index, PHOTO_URL AS photo_url, ADDRESS AS address, PHONE AS phone, STATUS AS status, TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt, TO_CHAR(updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS updatedAt FROM MP_RESTAURANT WHERE ID = #{id} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE MP_RESTAURANT SET NAME = #{name}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, CATEGORY = #{category}, PHOTO_URL = #{photo_url}, ADDRESS = #{address}, PHONE = #{phone}, STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{id}
